items.title: From a Cache Header to a $400 Bug Bounty: My API Security Research

items.title: $1,024 for making Discourse choke on one really long draft
items.author: Pawan Jaiswal

items.title: The bug that made a forum grind to 32 seconds a page — for $1,024
